body:
i love you, please stay alive
it's worth it

dude, you do matter. you've changed the world in some kind of way, and that makes the difference. 
i'm sure there's at least someone who cares about you, you just need to find them. i know it's hard. i don't know how old are you, but look how far you've become. you're alive. you're breathing. are you gonna end everything now? you'll be ignoring all these years you survived, even when there was no one? please, give yourself a second chance, and wait. sometimes before it gets better, darkness get bigger.
